## Checklist

- [ ] `make validate` passes (swift-format + SwiftLint, build, test).
- [ ] New/changed `BannerShiftCore` logic has tests.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in the `Unreleased` section of `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No new entitlements (or they're justified above).
- [ ] Lint findings are fixed, not suppressed (any suppression is scoped to one line with a `// Reason:` comment and noted here).
- [ ] Changes to undocumented macOS internals (banner subroles, panel identifier, the full-screen container invariant) are explained above.
